folder.description: Folder the site serves its files from, from the account's file root, e.g. '/mysite.nekoweb.org'. It must exist.

main.description: Make this your main site: it's shown when you follow other sites, and your username subdomain redirects to it. Only one site can be main, so this takes it from the current one.

nice_links.description: Serve /page.html at /page. Turning this off again breaks links that leave out .html.

nsfw.description: Mark the site as NSFW. It then can't be reached from the UK.

show_in_global_feed.description: Show the site's RSS posts in the global feed.

site.description: Domain of one of your sites, e.g. 'mysite.nekoweb.org'. Omit for the site the API key belongs to.

strict_slash.description: Only with nice links: /page.html is served only at /page, and /page/index.html only at /page/ (like Neocities).

support_http.description: Allow plain HTTP as well as HTTPS.

visible.description: Show the site in Explore and on Follows pages.

title: Update site settings
